XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Noise/vibrations coming from the engine compartment, air conditioning compressor area
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: engine management | injection | noise | knocking | ticking | air conditioning | engine compartment

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: All vehicles

  • System: Air conditioning

  • Device: Air conditioning compressor/condenser pipe

  • Fault: Noise/vibration coming from the engine compartment, air conditioning compressor area

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Knocking of the pipe connecting the air conditioning compressor to the condenser against the bulkhead

• Action: Replace the pipe connecting the air conditioning compressor to the condenser with a new model featuring a different route (code 51826188).

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: - -
